import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import uuid

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import observe

env = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1')
for key in list(env):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del env[key]
name = 'stackd-connection-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
path = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/eventbridge/connections.json')
result = {'account': '000000000000', 'region': 'us-west-2', 'name': name, 'observations': [], 'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'value_provenance': 'Every credential is an intentionally synthetic probe value; no external provider accepts it.'}
if path.exists():
    result['earlier_attempt'] = json.loads(path.read_text())
secret = None
managed_secrets = set()
created = False

def call(label, service, operation, payload):
    started = int(time.time()*1000)
    response = observe(service, operation, payload, env, paginate=False)
    result['observations'].append({'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': payload, 'request_started_ms': started, 'request_finished_ms': int(time.time()*1000), 'result': response})
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(label, response['code'], flush=True)
    return response

def success(response):
    if response['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(response)
    return response['output']

def describe(label):
    info = success(call(label, 'events', 'describe-connection', {'Name': name}))
    managed_secrets.add(info['SecretArn'])
    return info

try:
    call('linked-role-before', 'iam', 'get-role', {'RoleName': 'AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEventBridgeApiDestinations'})
    created = True
    success(call('create-basic', 'events', 'create-connection', {'Name': name, 'Description': 'owned connection evidence', 'AuthorizationType': 'BASIC', 'AuthParameters': {'BasicAuthParameters': {'Username': 'owned-user', 'Password': 'owned-inert-password'}, 'InvocationHttpParameters': {'HeaderParameters': [{'Key': 'x-public', 'Value': 'visible'}, {'Key': 'x-private', 'Value': 'owned-inert-header', 'IsValueSecret': True}], 'BodyParameters': [{'Key': 'body', 'Value': 'connection-body'}], 'QueryStringParameters': [{'Key': 'query', 'Value': 'connection-query'}]}}}))
    info = describe('describe-basic')
    secret = info['SecretArn']
    call('describe-managed-secret', 'secretsmanager', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': secret})
    call('get-managed-secret', 'secretsmanager', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': secret})
    call('list-managed-versions', 'secretsmanager', 'list-secret-version-ids', {'SecretId': secret, 'IncludeDeprecated': True})
    call('reject-direct-secret-write', 'secretsmanager', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': secret, 'ClientRequestToken': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'SecretString': 'owned-direct-write-probe'})
    call('update-password-without-type', 'events', 'update-connection', {'Name': name, 'AuthParameters': {'BasicAuthParameters': {'Password': 'owned-inert-password-two'}}})
    success(call('update-password-with-type', 'events', 'update-connection', {'Name': name, 'AuthorizationType': 'BASIC', 'AuthParameters': {'BasicAuthParameters': {'Password': 'owned-inert-password-two'}}}))
    describe('describe-password-updated')
    call('get-updated-managed-secret', 'secretsmanager', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': secret})
    success(call('update-description-only', 'events', 'update-connection', {'Name': name, 'Description': 'description update'}))
    describe('describe-description-updated')
    call('list-after-description', 'secretsmanager', 'list-secret-version-ids', {'SecretId': secret, 'IncludeDeprecated': True})
    success(call('deauthorize', 'events', 'deauthorize-connection', {'Name': name}))
    describe('describe-deauthorized')
    call('get-deauthorized-secret', 'secretsmanager', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': secret})
    call('deauthorize-again', 'events', 'deauthorize-connection', {'Name': name})
    success(call('switch-to-api-key', 'events', 'update-connection', {'Name': name, 'AuthorizationType': 'API_KEY', 'AuthParameters': {'ApiKeyAuthParameters': {'ApiKeyName': 'x-owned-key', 'ApiKeyValue': 'owned-inert-api-key'}}}))
    info = describe('describe-api-key')
    call('get-replaced-secret', 'secretsmanager', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': secret})
    secret = info['SecretArn']
    call('get-api-key-secret', 'secretsmanager', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': secret})
    call('list-owned', 'events', 'list-connections', {'NamePrefix': name})
    call('linked-role-after', 'iam', 'get-role', {'RoleName': 'AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEventBridgeApiDestinations'})
finally:
    if created:
        call('cleanup-delete-connection', 'events', 'delete-connection', {'Name': name})
        for attempt in range(60):
            absent = call('cleanup-connection-absence-' + str(attempt), 'events', 'describe-connection', {'Name': name})
            if absent['code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                break
            time.sleep(2)
    result['managed_secret_cleanup'] = {}
    for index, owned_secret in enumerate(sorted(managed_secrets)):
        for attempt in range(90):
            absent = call('cleanup-secret-' + str(index) + '-absence-' + str(attempt), 'secretsmanager', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': owned_secret})
            if absent['code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                result['managed_secret_cleanup'][owned_secret] = 'independently absent'
                break
            time.sleep(2)
        else:
            result['managed_secret_cleanup'][owned_secret] = 'absence not yet observed'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
